selection_method: Ten distinct public official project OpenAPI source files preselected before content analysis, pinned to exact commit and Git blob
prohibitions: No requests to vendors' live API hosts or production servers
No authentication credentials or environment secrets
No execution of third-party repository code
No auto-submitted issues or pull requests
No bypass of safety filters, permissions or access restrictions

test_design.phase_1: Fetch each exact public pinned GitHub raw file once; SHA1 git-blob identity, exact size, SHA256 source fingerprint; no substitution if unavailable
test_design.phase_2: Run unchanged qualified v0.9.6 offline risu-probe scan and first-check on each separate single-spec project directory; 512KiB per-file scanner limit retained
test_design.phase_3: Independent read-only OpenAPI inventory: version, GET operation count, explicit non-2xx response coverage, local unreferenced example coverage; never call actual endpoints
test_design.phase_4: Classify new evidence as observed scanner signal, unsupported, no finding, spec-only candidate; CONFIRMED_CONSUMER_MISMATCH requires actual pinned consumer code and independently replayed observation, not spec-only inference
test_design.phase_5: Stop/pivot criterion: if zero verified consumer impact and poor support in ten, freeze rather than invent incidents or expand features
test_design.full_first_diagnosis_minutes: NOT_MEASURED without independent developer; tool-only scan wall time measured separately

outcome_labels_not_equal: Harness execution time != independent developer first-diagnosis time
